item.title: Day dock fees at The Bay regarded as at the 'lower end'

item.title: Marian Anderson property redevelopment plan advances
item.description: The transformation of a long-blighted brownfield site owned by the city of Sarasota in Newtown has advanced another step as the City Commission, on second reading, unanimously approved a land use designation change on the property.At their Feb. 2 meeting, commissioners put their final stamp on a future land use category change of 9.22 acres, at what is called the Marian Anderson site, from Community Commercial to Production Intensive Commercial. item.title: Developer introduces luxury-branded downtown condo tower
item.description: New York City.Costa Rica.Pompano Beach.Denver.Dubai.Sarasota?What do they all have in common? All of them either are or soon will be home to the first six Waldorf Astoria-branded luxury condominiums. And they will eventually joined by locations in Fredericksburg, Texas; Turks & Caicos; and San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. item.title: Sarasota County to buy prominent Stickney Point property for $21M project
item.description: Sarasota County is primed to buy one of the most notable properties in the region, a colorful gateway to Siesta Key that includes bay frontage, docks, water sports outposts and even a restaurant, in a $18.1 million deal. And, in the years ahead, the skyline there could look much different — with some buildings poised for demolition to make way for a public park, according to the county's plans. item.title: Bulk garbage pickups likely to return for Manatee County residents
item.description: Within a 15-minute presentation about Manatee County’s new garbage collection system, Director of Utilities Patrick Shea used one word that sums up the public’s response to the changes — consternation. Whether it’s once a week pickup, the size of the cans, or the elimination of bulk pickup, residents from every area of the county have come forward with complaints.
